subject: Next Steps: Demo Timing + Trial Playbook Sync
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Turner <nicole.turner@carelytics.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@carelytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next Steps: Demo Timing + Trial Playbook Sync

Hi Nicole / Sam —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — good to hear more about the Carelytics ingestion patterns and the two pilot use cases you described (chart summarization for clinicians and patient-risk batch scoring). Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can lock timelines: 

Recap (from today's call)
- Primary goals: validate 95% coverage on clinician summary prompts, measure end-to-end latency for batch scoring at 10k messages/day.
- Success criteria (what you'd like to see in the pilot): quality threshold for summaries (precision/recall targets), throughput target (sustained tokens/sec), and basic data residency requirements.
- Stakeholders: Nicole (product owner), Sam (platform/infra), plus your security reviewer (TBD).

Proposed next steps
1) Demo + tech deep-dive (30–45m): show prompt flow, latency profile, and integration options. I suggest two potential windows below.
2) Trial plan sync (45m): align on trial scope, prompt set for evals, acceptance criteria, and who owns test data. I can run through a draft playbook.
3) Security kickoff (30m, optional): include Karthik and our security lead if you need to review retention/KMS questions.

Availability (PDT) — pick any 1 slot for the demo + then we'll follow with the trial sync same week:
- Tue Jul 25: 10:00–10:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Wed Jul 26: 09:00–09:45 or 16:00–16:45

I've attached a short draft trial playbook (v0.9) and a calendar ICS with the above slots as placeholders. If none of these work, tell me a few times that do and I'll align.

Attachments: [Carelytics-trial-playbook-v0.9.pdf (application/pdf)], [proposed-demo-slots.ics (text/calendar)]

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

—Ben

Thanks Ben — helpful recap. Quick answers from our side:

- We like the proposed cadence: demo first, then trial sync.
- Stakeholders who should join: Nicole (me, product), Sam (platform), Julian (security lead cc'd below in a follow-up), and one of our ML engineers (TBD).

Availability (EDT):
- Tue Jul 25: 13:00–13:45 EDT (works for Sam and me)
- Wed Jul 26: 12:00–12:45 EDT (also OK, but prefer Tue)

A couple of prep items: can you include an example prompt set and a short note on how you measure summary quality (what metrics you use)? Also, when you say data residency options, can you confirm if Redwood supports VPC/private deployments for pilot data during the evaluation?

I'll loop Julian on the security thread after we lock the time.

Thanks,
Nicole

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next Steps: Demo Timing + Trial Playbook Sync

Great — Tue Jul 25 at 13:00 EDT (10:00 PDT) works for us. I've tentatively held the 10:00–10:45 PDT demo slot. 

Quick answers to Nicole's prep items:
- Prompt set: attached as a short excerpt in the trial playbook (v0.9). For the meeting I'll bring a sample 12-prompt pack that maps to the clinician summary flows you described.
- Quality metrics we use during pilots: ROUGE-L for structural similarity, BLEU as a secondary comparator for templated bits, and a human-rated clarity score (1–5) for clinical usefulness. We'll go through how we instrument those during the trial sync.
- Data residency: Redwood supports Private (VPC) trials — we can run the evaluation in a customer VPC with KMS integration for keys. Karthik will handle the security/deployment details on the follow-up call.

Next steps: I've created a tentative calendar event and included the core agenda — demo (30m), Q&A (10m), immediate next actions (5m). Please confirm and I'll send the invite with dial-in details.

Attachments: [Carelytics-trial-playbook-v0.9.pdf]

—Ben

From: Sam Park <sam.park@carelytics.com>

Subject: Re: Next Steps: Demo Timing + Trial Playbook Sync

Appreciate the quick follow-up — confirming on our side. Two notes from platform: 

1) For the trial environment we'll need an approximate estimate of peak concurrent inference (tokens/sec) and peak storage (GB) so we can provision a staging VPC. Can you provide a short sizing estimate before the trial sync?
2) Security will want the SOC2 scope and whether PII will be included in any prompt logs during the pilot. If you can flag where PII may appear in the playbook that helps speed our internal review.

If helpful, Karthik / Monica — can we include a one-paragraph sizing note in the calendar invite body so Sam's infra team sees it before the demo?

—Sam
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@carelytics.com>, Nicole Turner <nicole.turner@carelytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next Steps: Demo Timing + Trial Playbook Sync

Thanks Sam — noted. Attaching a short sizing/ops note here and pasting the highlights below so it appears in the event body: 

Sizing & operations snapshot (for staging VPC)
- Expected pilot throughput: up to ~12k messages/day across 3 prompt types; typical prompt length ~600 tokens; peak concurrent generation ~6–8 requests/sec (batched to reduce per-token cost).
- Storage needs: ~30–50 GB for logs and cached artifacts during a 4-week pilot (depends on retention).
- PII handling: playbook marks fields that may contain PII (patient names, MRN). Default configuration masks PII at tokenization and we can ensure logs redact PII; we'll discuss retention window and KMS keys on the security call.

Calendar: I've sent the confirmed invite for Tue Jul 25 13:00–13:45 EDT (10:00–10:45 PDT). Invite includes the agenda and the sizing snapshot above; Julian (security) — please join if you can, otherwise I'll send a separate security distribution with Karthik.

Looking forward to the demo.

—Ben
